name: ad-user-win
description: Practice-box helper (Active Directory, DC-only): creates or updates a domain user. Vars: USERNAME (required); PASSWORD (required on first create -- New-ADUser cannot make an enabled account without one); FULLNAME (optional, sets DisplayName); DESCRIPTION (optional); SPN (optional, registers one service principal name -- makes the account kerberoastable); NO_PREAUTH (optional, default 0 -- '1' disables Kerberos preauthentication, the AS-REP-roasting misconfiguration); NEVER_EXPIRES (optional, default 0 -- '1' sets PasswordNeverExpires); DES_ONLY (optional, default 0 -- '1' restricts the account to DES Kerberos encryption, the crypto-downgrade misconfiguration). Idempotent: an existing account is updated in place and re-enabled, never recreated. Must run on a domain controller (or RSAT host) AFTER the domain exists. Pairs with powershell_json checks over Get-ADUser (-Properties DoesNotRequirePreauth, ServicePrincipalNames, msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes) and credential bind attempts.
